card.fires_on: The word "not" (sometimes "but" before "not") in running prose, especially right after a comma, dash or "is", in historical or religious text. It also fires weakly on digits inside ISBNs and page counts.

modes.description: "not" or "but" introducing a contrast or negated clause in historical or religious prose.

card.plain: It lights up on the word "not" when a sentence turns to deny or contrast something, mostly in history or scripture.
